3050.title: System child-outcome provenance stops before provider dispatch
3050.rootCauseOneLine: The server stores child-outcome taxonomy on its event but constructs a strict provider-bound turn.submit command that cannot carry that taxonomy or aggregate linkage.
3050.proposedFix: Choose a server policy for authoritative suppression or add structured child and aggregate provenance end to end through turn.submit and provider runtime input.
3050.caveats: The deterministic server-to-provider dispatch boundary was reproduced; a live provider reply was not needed or exercised.
